name: Lumines
source:
Summoned by [url=/c23635]Roro[/url] to serve as her familiar.

Lumines age is unknown but looks a bit older than Roro.

She enjoys playing pranks and has a bit of a sadistic side to her. With a fun-loving personality she loves anything fun complimenting her normally innocent, cheerful, and childlike demeanor.

Lumines is curious about [url=/c42047]Tomohiro[/url], who produces semen that amplifies magical power when consumed.

The wings on her back can be removed at will. She has a body that is very sensitive. When having sex her appearance changes from her normal self to a more seductive one, yet one thing remains the same she enjoys teasing Tomohiro.

[Translated from [url=https://hadashi.product.co.jp/3ping/char.html]the game's Official Homepage[/url].]
